name: Imagined 5 GW AI factory — Gulf Coast

names.zh: 想象中的 5 GW AI 工厂——美国墨西哥湾沿岸

label: Imagined — a fictional design built from public numbers
label_zh: 想象设计——依据公开数据构建的虚构方案
famous_for: AI factory campus: 5,001 MW IT, 2,681,856 GPUs, PUE 1.17 — designed by us, checked by the engine
story: An imagined AI factory on empty land on the US Gulf Coast: 8 halls, 388 identical pods of 96 GB200 NVL72 rack systems, 2,681,856 GPUs. The grid arrives at 400 kV; gas turbines and batteries carry it through outages. Each pod's racks are cooled 70 % by liquid (CDUs to dry coolers) and 30 % by air. At a summer afternoon the engine finds 5,001 MW of IT, PUE 1.17 and 11,146 million tokens a second from a 70B model — and 21.6 million tonnes of CO₂ a year on today's grid mix.
notable: 388 pods × 96 GB200 NVL72 rack systems (120 kW each from the catalog) = 2,681,856 GPUs.
Per pod the engine sees 12,888.4 kW IT, 15,100.5 kW facility, PUE 1.17 and 28,726,819 tokens/s at the design afternoon.
24 CoolIT CHx750 CDUs per pod carry 70 % of the heat as liquid; Vertiv Liebert CW CRAHs take the rest.
A year at 0.065 USD/kWh: $3336 M for 51,324,840 MWh; 21,556 kt CO₂ at 420 g/kWh.
Catalog list prices cover 5 of 8 part types per pod; the GB200 NVL72 has no list price in the catalog, so the BOM leaves it out.
assumptions: Scale: 5,000 MW IT target from the brief (IMAGINED-GIANTS.md §1); the pod count is that target ÷ the engine's pod IT load.
Rack system: catalog record rack_system/nvidia/gb200-nvl72, 120 kW IT, 72 GPUs, 70 % liquid-cooled (catalog thermal data).
Cooling: cdu/coolit/chx750 CDUs (750 kW, catalog) in loops of 3 per row, N+1; heat rejected to dry coolers; crah/vertiv/liebert-cw CRAHs (120 kW) on a chilled-water plant for the air share.

Power: 2N from a 400 kV substation through ATS (grid / genset bank), transformers, switchboards and MW-class UPS banks (generic nodes: no MW-class UPS in the catalog), busway taps per rack; standby genset banks of Cat 3516C (2 MW standby, catalog); on-site gas turbines + batteries (sized as the genset bank in the model).
Climate: a July day at 29 °C mean with a 9 °C daily swing and 70 % RH (typical July climate for the region); the numbers are read at 15:00 local, the warmest hour.
Grid factor 420 g CO₂/kWh and tariff 0.065 USD/kWh: dc-world/reports/giants-references.md §2 / §3.
Tokens: every rack serves a 70B chat model at 70–95 % load (engine estimate from GPU memory bandwidth and FLOPS; labelled estimated, not a benchmark).
Water: closed-loop dry coolers, no consumptive water (evaporative trim not modelled).
Estate: the DR and peer sites, link capacities and carriers are part of the imagined design, not real contracts; latency is estimated from distance.

References for scale, cooling and power patterns: §1.1 Stargate Abilene (scale, DLC + CDUs, PUE 1.12–1.15); §1.2 Hyperion & Prometheus (GW campus, 500 kV, gas backstop); §1.3 Colossus (on-site turbines + BESS, 100k GPUs in one fabric); §2.1 ERCOT grid factor ~400 g/kWh and ~$0.065/kWh (dc-world/reports/giants-references.md).

derived.basis: engine on the representative hall (hall.json) at 15:00 local, mid-July, scaled by the pod count; rounded

waterM3PerDay.note: closed-loop dry coolers: no consumptive water; evaporative trim on the hottest days is not modelled

zh.famous_for: AI 工厂园区：IT 5,001 MW、2,681,856 块 GPU、PUE 1.17——由我们设计，经引擎校验
zh.story: 想象中的 AI 工厂，建在美国墨西哥湾沿岸的一片空地上：8 个机房、388 个相同的单元，每个单元 96 台 GB200 NVL72 整机柜，共 2,681,856 块 GPU。电网以 400 kV 接入，燃气轮机和电池在停电时顶上。每台机柜 70% 的热量走液冷（CDU 到干冷器），30% 走风冷。夏季午后，引擎算出 IT 负载 5,001 MW、PUE 1.17，70B 模型每秒约 11,146 百万 Token；按当前电网结构，每年排放约 2,156 万吨 CO₂。
zh.water: 闭式干冷器：不消耗水；最热天的蒸发辅助冷却未模拟
assumptions: 规模：IT 目标 5,000 MW（来自 IMAGINED-GIANTS.md §1）；单元数 = 该目标 ÷ 引擎算出的单元 IT 负载。
整机柜：目录记录 rack_system/nvidia/gb200-nvl72，IT 120 kW、72 块 GPU，70% 液冷（目录热参数）。
冷却：cdu/coolit/chx750 CDU（750 kW，目录），每列 3 台组成环路，N+1；热量排向干冷器；风冷部分由 crah/vertiv/liebert-cw 精密空调（120 kW，冷冻水）承担。
供电：400 kV 变电站 2N 接入，经 ATS（市电 / 柴发组）、变压器、配电柜和兆瓦级 UPS（通用节点：目录中没有兆瓦级 UPS），每台机柜由母线槽插接箱供电；备用电源为 Cat 3516C 柴发组（2 MW 备用，目录）；现场燃气轮机 + 电池（模型中按柴发组容量计）。
气候：七月典型日，平均 29 °C、昼夜温差 9 °C、相对湿度 70%；数值取当地 15:00，即最热的时段。
电网排放因子 420 g CO₂/kWh，电价 0.065 USD/kWh：dc-world/reports/giants-references.md §2 / §3。
Token：每台机柜以 70–95% 负载运行一个 70B 对话模型（引擎根据 GPU 显存带宽和算力估算，标注为估算，并非基准测试）。
用水：闭式干冷器，不消耗水（未模拟蒸发辅助冷却）。
网络：灾备与对等站点、链路容量和运营商都是想象设计的一部分，并非真实合同；时延按距离估算。

规模、冷却和供电方式的参考：§1.1 Stargate Abilene (scale, DLC + CDUs, PUE 1.12–1.15)；§1.2 Hyperion & Prometheus (GW campus, 500 kV, gas backstop)；§1.3 Colossus (on-site turbines + BESS, 100k GPUs in one fabric)；§2.1 ERCOT grid factor ~400 g/kWh and ~$0.065/kWh（dc-world/reports/giants-references.md）。
